summary: Check which PowerShell version Ansible uses by running win_powershell to output $PSVersionTable.PSVersion and printing it with debug. win_powershell runs in the same interpreter context as other modules, so it can inspect the target's PowerShell environment.
questions: How do I check which PowerShell version Ansible is using on a host?
How can I verify ansible_pwsh_interpreter took effect?
Can win_powershell show installed modules on the target?

answer_card.title: Checking which PowerShell version Ansible uses
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Display PowerShell version info
  ansible.windows.win_powershell:
    script: $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString()
  register:
    ps_version: _task.result.output[0]

- debug:
    var: ps_version
```

`win_powershell` runs in the same interpreter context as other PowerShell modules, so you can also use it to inspect installed modules, available cmdlets and other details of the target's PowerShell environment.
